newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end calm bourse session stable.
newsitem.headline: German shares end calm bourse session stable.

text.p: German shares ended a calm bourse session marginally firmer on Wednesday, with any meaningful gains stifled by lacklustre investor activity in the wake of last week's record-breaking performance.
The 30-share blue chip DAX index ended floor trade up 3.88 points at 2,655.73, having been well supported around the 2,640 level, dealers said, noting there was no concerted selling pressure.
"We are low on economic news, low on corporate news. This market is really still drawing breath after the push upward we had last week," said a Munich dealer.
The faltering dollar combined with the prospect of Germany's public holiday on Thursday, which marks the country's unification, to keep activity low.
